backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: adding 'Why Choose Us', 'Privacy Policy', and 'Terms & Conditions' links to the mobile hamburger menu, and adding corresponding translation keys for all three supported languages.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to short summaries describing each component's purpose and notable implementation details, used for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including color tokens for background, foreground, primary, border, and chart variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with a root div and a module script tag loading main.tsx, titled 'True Origin Company LLP'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app shell using TanStack Router with a NavBar component featuring desktop and mobile menus, page routes for home, privacy policy, terms and conditions, export certification, and a WhyChooseUsRedirect component that redirects /why-choose-us to the home page.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component rendering a checklist, operations list, and vision/mission cards using translated strings from the LanguageContext.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with an info panel showing address, phone, and email details, plus an enquiry form with submission state, all using translated keys from LanguageContext.
frontend/src/components/ExportCargoSecti: Renders a landing page section about export cargo, displaying a heading, subheading, a cargo ship image, and three highlight cards with icons and translated text.
frontend/src/components/ExportCertificat: Full-page component displaying export certifications, quality control steps, and product-specific packaging/documentation details with images and i18n support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, contact details, quick navigation links that support smooth-scrolling from any route, and legal/policy links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, overlay, headline, subheadline, CTA buttons linking to the export certification page and contact section, and a scroll-down indicator.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown component that lets users switch between English, Hindi, and Marathi, with styling that adapts based on whether the navbar is scrolled.
frontend/src/components/PrivacyPolicyPag: Standalone privacy policy page that renders numbered sections from i18n keys, a header with a back link, and a contact callout at the bottom.
Products section displaying a grid of four product cards (moringa, curry leaves, vegetables, custom sourcing) with images and icons, plus a farm image gallery below.
frontend/src/components/QualityComplianc: Renders a 'Quality & Compliance' section with a grid of six documentation items and a CTA link to the export-certification page, using i18n translations.
frontend/src/components/SocialMediaSecti: Displays a social media section with three placeholder video cards (marked 'coming soon') and Instagram/YouTube icon links, using i18n translations.
frontend/src/components/TermsAndConditio: Renders a full Terms and Conditions page with eight translated sections, a back-home link, and a contact email callout at the bottom.
Displays a 'Why Choose Us' page with a hero header, eight differentiator cards with icons, a stats banner, and a CTA that navigates to the contact section on the home page.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for language switching (en/hi/mr) with a translation lookup function that falls back to English or the raw key.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Playfair Display and Poppins fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and sets base Tailwind styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/translations/translations.t: Defines a `Language` type and a `translations` record containing UI string keys for English, Hindi, and Marathi, covering navigation, hero, about, and other site sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (emerald, gold, cream), fonts (Playfair Display, Poppins), shadows, border radii, and accordion animations, plus typography and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's versioned state for the TrueOrigin Exports B2B site, recording existing implemented features (mobile nav links, translation keys) and architectural notes about the multilingual hamburger menu.
